description: The Forge is a large industrial workshop clustered around a tall central furnace and chimney. Orange fire shines from the furnace base onto the dark metal floor. Benches, small worktables and stools fill the side bays, with tools, scrap and mechanical parts covering many surfaces. Racks of equipment line the walls, and lamps hang among heavy pipes and structural beams. Another smaller glowing furnace sits on the left. The open strip through the middle connects the lower entrance to the main forge, while the crowded outer work areas make this a room of fabrication, repairs and stored hardware.
